outgoing_60s.open: Hi, this is {name} from Performance Supply Depot — did I catch you at a bad time? Could I grab just a minute of your time?
outgoing_60s.body: Deliver the ONE thing (new product line / quote / reorder nudge) in ~60 seconds.
outgoing_60s.close: Thank you so much for your time. I hope we can earn your business in the future.
outgoing_60s.tone: Graceful, no pressure, no hard sell.

incoming_8min.open: Hi, this is Performance Supply Depot — we saw a missed call from this number. Is there anything we can do for you, or would you like to order supplies?
incoming_8min.body: Learn who they are + what they need (order / support / info).
incoming_8min.close: Capture the order OR log a follow-up, then close politely.
